# shuang

Freeze apps when the VPN drops: a per-application kill switch that suspends instead of killing. GPL-3.0, no server, no telemetry.

Install:

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/rasuvaeff/shuang
# or
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rasuvaeff/shuang/master/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

## Rules

- Fail-closed: unknown IP (no quorum) is never allowed.
- The whole process tree is frozen (SIGSTOP / NtSuspendProcess), not just the root pid.
- The config file is never rewritten: `shuang allow` and profile selection write `state.toml`.
- Ctrl+C/SIGTERM resumes everything frozen; frozen pids persist for crash recovery.
- No network traffic except the configured IP/country checks (leaks also asks ip-api.com for reputation).

## API

```
shuang check [--json] [--config PATH]      # exit 0 allowed, 3 not allowed, 1 error
shuang allow <ip|cidr|CC> [--config PATH]  # append to state.toml
shuang run [--config PATH] -- <cmd...>     # exit 69 bad IP at start, 75 stopped mid-run
shuang daemon [--no-tray] [--no-notify] [--config PATH]
shuang leaks [--config PATH]               # per-service, /cdn-cgi-trace, DNS, reputation; exit 4 on problems
shuang doctor [--config PATH]              # environment diagnostics; exit 4 on problems
shuang events [--tail N]
shuang stats [--tail N]                    # VPN health over 7 days
shuang profile [<name|none>]               # list / activate / deactivate profiles
shuang deny <ip|cidr|CC> [--config PATH]   # remove a state.toml allowlist entry
shuang fix <disable-ipv6|enable-ipv6|dns-public>  # close a leak (or print the sudo command)

# daemon also serves a local web panel (127.0.0.1 + one-time token):
# live status, allow/deny management, profiles, leaks/doctor/stats buttons,
# leak fixes, and settings (interval/grace/close/min_agree/notify,
# trust-this-network). Panel writes go to state.toml; config.toml is never
# rewritten. Settings in state.toml override config values on load.
```

`check --json` shape (public contract, additive only):

```json
{"ipv4": "203.0.113.7", "ipv6": null, "country": "NL", "quorum": true, "allowed": true}
```

Config (`~/.config/shuang/config.toml`, all keys optional; missing file = defaults):

```toml
[[apps]]
name = "claude-code"
match = ["claude", "args:claude", "/MyApp.app/"]
[apps.allow]                  # optional per-app rules (additive union)
countries = ["NL"]

[allow]                       # global allowlist
ips = ["203.0.113.42"]
nets = ["185.12.40.0/24"]
countries = ["NL"]

[ip_check]
ip_services = [...]           # default: ipify, icanhazip, ident.me, checkip.amazonaws.com
ipv6_services = [...]
country_services = ["https://api.country.is"]
min_agree = 2
interval_secs = 5             # poll backstop; netlink events react instantly (Linux)
timeout_secs = 5

[timing]
grace_secs = 20               # CLOCK_BOOTTIME-based: survives laptop sleep
close_secs = 5
freeze_on_event_first = false # paranoid: freeze on network event before re-check

[watchdog]
processes = ["v2ray"]         # freeze when the local proxy client dies

[reputation]
enabled = false               # freeze while the exit carries proxy/hosting flags
fail_flags = ["proxy", "hosting"]

[profiles.work]               # `shuang profile work` activates
countries = ["NL", "DE"]

trusted_networks = ["aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff"]  # gateway MACs where protection is off

[route_check]
enabled = true            # daemon freezes on split-routing (trace != exits)
every_secs = 30
services = [...]  # default: claude.ai, api.anthropic.com, chatgpt.com, api.openai.com, www.perplexity.ai
```

Empty allowlist + `run` = the startup addresses are allowed (freeze on change).
